title: Rooms Signal Delay Set — payload
description: A holder of `admin` changes whether the room's host waits a randomised interval before sending a `rooms/changed` signal — the room's signal delay.

roomId.description: The room whose signal delay to change. A host verifies the presentation against credentials issued by this identifier, never against a member list of its own.

presentation.description: Must confer `admin` at this room's scope: the setting changes what the timing of every member's signals gives away, so it takes the grant that decides the room's other terms.

signalDelay.description: The room's signal delay from now on. Always stated: a request that left it out cannot be read as one that meant either value.

reason.description: Why, for the room's audit trail. REQUIRED: turning the delay off changes what the timing of every member's signals reveals, so the change carries its own account of intent. Plain text; it MUST NOT name a member or quote a record.

Response.title: Rooms Signal Delay Set — response payload

signalDelay.description: The signal delay now in force, as the host recorded it — what `rooms/info` will serve every member.

previous.description: The signal delay it replaced — `randomised` for a room that had never set one. Returned so that a surface can say whether anything changed.
